obernants.operator: U minus graph(S) excludes unnormalized Some, wrong LCM or wrong solution class, None for compatible reached prefix, accepting a zero modulus, wrong first zero index, and an overflow not selected by the left-to-right policy. Mathematical unsatisfiability of the entire list alone does not force None when an earlier merge overflows.
obernants.domain: Finite slices of u64 congruences and candidate Result<Option<Congruence>,Error> observations, with normal terminating execution.

obernants.operator: For Some(r,M), all compatible input lists whose total LCM is M and whose intersection is r+M*Z reconstruct the output, with r<M and M>0. Many lists fit: [(8,18)] and [(2,6),(8,9)]. Prefix LCM divides final M, hence no overflow occurs for these valid lists. Error and None preimages additionally obey the preflight and first terminal prefix policy; they do not uniquely recover inputs.
